verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken leaderboard layout. The RSVP CTA is shrunk into a pill that looks like the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS badges, so the call to action no longer stands out. The time and venue line is cut off from its date and stranded at the far right. A red placeholder chip for a missing asset is left in the badge row, and the left-column copy is tiny and cramped. B is slightly worse because its pills overlap each other (FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS collide), and its can graphic is more crushed and awkwardly placed. A's pills sit side by side with small gaps.
